## Omitted Supporting Objects

This focused subset omits the full-package `README.md`, `PRIOR_WORK.md`,
`INTERNAL_DOSSIER.md`, `SCOPE_BRIEF.md`, historical-recurrence and additive-
equivalence analyses, parent-admission matrix, iterative DAG, restart taxonomy,
claim matrix, contradictions register, general operator taxonomy, source
identity manifest, crosswalk, future-author proposal/placeholders, TeX/PDF
placeholders, and all implementation/audit/test/study evidence. The exact
omitted package paths are listed in the source-byte report.

## Review Scope

The subset supports review of the exact ODQ-001F Disposition B development and
qualification architecture: baseline-relative purpose, separate identities,
complete claim layers, held-out access/multiplicity, replication/inference,
paired failure/unavailable and support accounting, causal stopping/adaptation,
metric safeguards, historical roles, generic profiles, exact decision effects,
and non-effects.

It does not support review or approval of the recovered historical recurrence,
additive equivalence, ODQ-001 or ODQ-001A–D semantics, parent-route admission,
an exact control execution profile, profile/domain/population selection,
metrics or thresholds, a parameter or stopping policy, a recurrence or method,
Stage B contents, implementation conformity, validation, achieved performance,
readiness, production, fallback availability, or Unity work.

## Supersession And Lifecycle State

For ODQ-001F owner review, this exact `r0.8` subset supersedes the generated
`SCI-FRUIT-v0.1-r0.7-owner-review-documents.tar.gz` subset. It does not
supersede the full Stage A package, prior owner directions, or adjacent frozen
authority.

ODQ-001F is not yet approved. This bundle is not an implementation-blind Stage
B packet, does not authorize its creation or dispatch, and does not launch the
empirical-development or qualification lane.
